name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current sex is female.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as female.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as male or other.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_turner_syndrome_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Turner syndrome.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of Turner syndrome.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of Turner syndrome.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Turner syndrome.

name: patient_has_finding_of_pre_pubertal_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently prepubertal.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently prepubertal.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not prepubertal.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently prepubertal.

name: patient_has_finding_of_tanner_stage_i_breast_development_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has Tanner stage I breast development.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has Tanner stage I breast development.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have Tanner stage I breast development.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has Tanner stage I breast development.

name: patient_body_height_measure_value_recorded_now_withunit_centimeter_per_year
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current height velocity in centimeters per year.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if the patient's current height velocity (in centimeters per year) is available.

name: patient_body_height_percentile_for_age_and_sex_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current height percentile for age and sex in the general population, expressed as a percentage.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such value is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured or calculated value if the patient's current height percentile for age and sex in the general population (as a percentage) is available.

name: patient_body_height_measurement_duration_available_for_height_velocity_calculation_in_months
meaning: Numeric value representing the number of months of accurate height measurements available for pre-study height velocity calculation.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of available accurate height measurements for pre-study height velocity calculation is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months for which accurate height measurements are available for the calculation of pre-study height velocity for the patient.

name: patient_has_finding_of_decreased_thyroxine_level_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has decreased thyroxine level.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has decreased thyroxine level (is thyroxine deficient).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have decreased thyroxine level.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has decreased thyroxine level.

name: patient_has_taken_thyroxine_inthehistory@@as_replacement_therapy
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever taken thyroxine in the past as replacement therapy.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever taken thyroxine in the past and it was received as replacement therapy.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has taken thyroxine in the past but not as replacement therapy.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the thyroxine was received as replacement therapy.

name: patient_has_finding_of_thyroid_function_tests_normal_inthepast6months@@continuous_for_6_months_prior_to_enrollment
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had normal thyroid function tests continuously for at least 6 months prior to enrollment.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had normal thyroid function tests continuously for at least 6 months prior to enrollment.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had normal thyroid function tests continuously for at least 6 months prior to enrollment.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had normal thyroid function tests continuously for at least 6 months prior to enrollment.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_somatropin_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever been exposed to somatropin (growth hormone) at any time in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever been exposed to somatropin (growth hormone) at any time in the past, including as prior treatment.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never been exposed to somatropin (growth hormone) at any time in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever been exposed to somatropin (growth hormone) at any time in the past.

name: patient_has_y_component_in_karyotype_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a Y component in their karyotype.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a Y component in their karyotype.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a Y component in their karyotype.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a Y component in their karyotype.

name: patient_has_gonads_in_situ_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has gonads in situ.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has gonads in situ (i.e., the gonads are present and have not been removed or ablated).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have gonads in situ (i.e., the gonads have been removed or ablated).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has gonads in situ.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_diabetes_mellitus_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of diabetes mellitus.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of diabetes mellitus.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of diabetes mellitus.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of diabetes mellitus.
